_readme: Website-only details that Loyverse cannot hold. Loyverse stays the master for items, sizes, prices and stock.
Keys under 'items' are Loyverse item names, exactly as they appear in the Loyverse item list (case is ignored).
Per item: image (a filename in src/assets), imageAlt, description, gender (women | men | unisex), hidden (true keeps it off the site), badge.
Items not listed here still appear, with the placeholder image, once they have a fixed price in Loyverse.
The items marked hidden carry placeholder prices entered on 24 Nov 2026. Remove 'hidden' once the owner confirms each price in Loyverse.
